metric_definitions.error_detection_unit: Clip/error type, not individual event intervals. Matching alert must fall after known onset and before correction end when supplied.
metric_definitions.false_clear: Predicted PASS when expected final state HOLD or REJECT, including uncertainty-only clips.
metric_definitions.lead_time_ms: Synthetic annotated last safe boundary minus alert video time; not physical or human prevention evidence.
metric_definitions.normal_false_holds_per_video_hour: Final false HOLD clip count divided by synthetic normal replay duration; not continuous alarms or operator interruption count.
metric_definitions.not_measured: Temporal IoU/interval F1 (predictions lack intervals), live camera/UI latency, real-world alarm burden, physical prevention and operator acknowledgements.
metric_definitions.onset_error_ms: First supported matching alert video time minus generator observable onset; negative alerts do not count as timely true detection.
metric_definitions.processing_latency_ms: Complete offline video analysis wall time including saving overlay evidence; not camera-to-alert/UI latency.
metric_definitions.status_accuracy: Exact final PASS/HOLD/REJECT agreement; every clip retained, including ERROR.
metric_definitions.supported_error: Structured matching reason with existing observation/evidence IDs and timestamp. Final-decision-only errors timed at final analyzed frame and separately tagged.
metric_definitions.uncertainty: Wilson95 descriptive clip interval; shared generator grammar precludes real-world statistical generalization.
